typography.family_appearance: modern grotesk sans-serif; clear Simplified Chinese sans-serif
typography.main_title: regular to medium, approximately 132-160 px at the default canvas, adjusted for title length
typography.caption_contrast: supporting captions are ink at 70-80% opacity, never light gray on ivory

connection_line_craft.stroke_weight: visible but light, consistent across the whole image
connection_line_craft.corner_style: soft right-angle or one-curve elbows, no long unchecked diagonals
connection_line_craft.label_care: edge labels sit in reserved gaps beside the line, never overlapping strokes or node text
connection_line_craft.arrowhead: single, small, filled, exactly at the destination edge

microtexture.rule: optional quiet paper grain at 2-4% strength, no dot grids, no halftone

copy_rules.eyebrow_length: 8-14 Chinese characters or a short English/Chinese label
copy_rules.headline_length: 10-16 Chinese characters; a full sentence reads better than a fragment
copy_rules.summary_length: one clause; it should add information, not repeat the headline
copy_rules.takeaway_rule: one sentence, factual; no imperative slogans, no exclamation marks
copy_rules.caption_length: 6-16 Chinese characters; write the concrete thing, not a category name
copy_rules.qualifier_use: only when the section has a real trigger condition; otherwise omit
copy_rules.footer_length: one or two sentences, state scope or evidence limits

visual_quote_weights.rule: In any layout, at most one shape or number is set in clay orange; indigo carries structure, periwinkle supports, orange only highlights the single declared key evidence, decision or transfer. Success/error states may use the quiet green/gray-brown tones above; orange is not a status color.

editorial.instructions: Keep the fixed two-column master: about 4% exterior margins, 25% left text column, 3% gutter and 66% right explanatory area. Use a fine vertical separator. The left contains an eyebrow label above a large regular-to-medium title, a concise one-clause summary and exactly one takeaway line. The right holds the content in declared section order with section titles, an optional qualifier and one short explanation each. A process can wrap with a visible continuation arrow. Do not put an enormous full-width title above this layout. Keep the same visual frame across topics; node count and flow direction adapt to the actual content.

chapters.instructions: Use the chapter master: a compact full-width heading, then spacious horizontal chapter bands separated by fine rules at the fixed section gap. Within each band put a large section number, heading, optional qualifier and one-sentence explanation on the left, and its technical relations on the right. Keep chapter headings at medium weight, never poster-black. Connect cross-section flows explicitly through reserved corridors. Use the actual declared number of sections; do not add a fake stage. Preserve the shared palette and lighter typography.

lanes.instructions: Use the lane master: a compact full-width title above clearly named horizontal lanes. Each lane represents an actual actor or execution phase with a quiet lane label. Keep node titles and short descriptions visible; route arrows between lanes through the reserved corridors, keeping feedback lines separate from forward flow and labeled with their actor and action. Do not assume every topic has offline and online stages. Preserve the shared palette and lighter typography.
